title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Hugging Face
providers.scope_notes: Covers Hugging Face Hub (Team / Enterprise / Enterprise Plus). Hosted Hub; token management needs Team or Enterprise, org revoke and service accounts need Enterprise, IP ranges need Enterprise Plus. Inference Endpoints use the same user access tokens.

controls.name: Token Exchange token duration
controls.what: Admins set issued token duration (8 h default, max 30 days) and can refresh the client secret.

controls.name: Token Exchange OAuth app set up by Hugging Face support
controls.what: Token Exchange only works through an org-bound OAuth app with the token-exchange privilege, which Hugging Face support sets up on request.

controls_unknown: Admin-enforced expiry for user access tokens or service account tokens (no setting found; PATs are valid until revoked).
Whether access tokens require or bypass an SSO session under Basic or Managed SSO.
Org-level allowlist or block for third-party OAuth apps.
Org-level control over who can configure Trusted Publishers on org repos.
Exact audit event name for OAuth Token Exchange issuance (docs say exchanges are logged).
Whether IP ranges apply to OAuth, Token Exchange and Trusted Publisher tokens.

authentication.summary: Backend uses an org-bound OAuth app's client credentials to mint hf_oauth_ tokens for any member by email, without the member's consent.

federation.details: Bridges an internal directory by email; not OIDC federation.

lifetime.summary: 8 h default, up to 30 days; no refresh

administration.summary: App set up through HF support; org admins can refresh the client secret and set token duration. Tokens are limited to org resources.

offboard.details: Issuance checks current org membership, so a removed user gets no new tokens; already-issued tokens are not addressed (they expire after 8 h by default).

inventory.details: No token list; all token exchanges appear in the org audit logs.

inventory.ui: Organization settings > Audit Logs (token exchanges are logged); download as JSON

offboard.ui: Organization settings > Members > revoke membership (or SCIM deprovision). Issued tokens are not revoked; they expire per the OAuth app's duration (8 h default)
offboard.api: SCIM: set user active=false or delete the user via SCIM

log_sources.name: Organization Audit Logs (UI or GET /api/organizations/{org}/audit-log/export)
log_sources.notes: Team & Enterprise. Membership, settings, repo and token-approval events; anonymized IP. Retention not stated.

lifecycle_events.notes: Docs say all exchanges are logged in org audit logs

anomaly_cues: Token exchanges for members who are not using the integration

containment.steps: Refresh the OAuth app client secret; issued tokens expire per configured duration.
containment.notes: Effect of secret refresh on issued tokens not stated.

calls.reveals: User, orgs and auth method of the token
calls.log_notes: Not among the documented audit event types
Org audit log has no download events
